No registry record could be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused, Google returned HTTP 429, Bing returned only irrelevant results (Norton, Randy Orton, IMI Orton), and zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com and instafinancials.com all returned 403/404. Therefore CIN, PAN, GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, MCA status and revenue are all null — not public/not retrievable within the tool budget, not invented. No basis for rejection: no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy was found, and the company's live website indicates an operating business. Role classified as manufacturer on the basis of the company's own claim (self-declared, not independently verified). Registered state (Maharashtra/Thane) is taken from the website footer only; the input did not state a state, so no mismatch can be assessed. HS 847490 (parts of machinery for sorting/screening mineral substances) is broadly consistent with the declared product range (vibrating screens/feeders), but this is a catalogue-level observation, not a customs finding. Revenue FY25/FY26: no audited accounts or official filings located — null.
